BASICS

Hello!
It seems like this is the first time you opened this program.
To get you started here are the basic controls:

- Drag with the right mouse button to move around
- Use the mouse wheel to zoom in/out
- Drag and drop generators from "Assets" onto this area

Try adding a generator:

Assets -> Generators -> Shaders -> Sources -> Basic

Select and drag "Spiral.glsl" onto the area next to this textbox.

HOW TO USE CONTROLS:

- Each "control" (aka sliders etc) have a small context menu to set various options
- The context menu can be opened via the ">" button on the LEFT of each control.
- Each control also has a link dragbutton on the right
- Drag ":" from any control onto another control to link them together

The idea of this program is that you can link each and every control with each other
allowing quite complex and creative setups.

Try it by linking "Control 1" to "Control 2" in the generator right next to here ->

VIEWS

You can also create specialized UI's by utilizing "View" generators, try it:

Assets -> Views

Select "Clipview.asset" and drag it onto this area.

Now you can drag other generators and assets into the grid cells.

You may also load "simple_demo" and "view_demo" projects for practical examples.
